subtitleAddAccount: Connect another mailbox over IMAP / SMTP.
subtitleWelcome: Email at the speed of thought. Add your first account to begin.

welcome.title: Welcome to Comail.
welcome.body: A fast, keyboard-first inbox. Connect an account, pick a look, learn three keys, and you're in. About a minute.

connect.title: Bring your inbox.
connect.body: Comail talks to your provider directly. Your password and mail never leave this computer.
connect.waitingHint: Finish signing in, then come back here.

personalize.title: Pick a look.
personalize.body: You can change this any time from the command bar ({{mod}}K) or Settings.

shortcuts.title: Learn the keys.
shortcuts.body: Comail is built to be driven from the keyboard. Try each one, the inbox on the right is a sandbox and nothing touches your mail.
shortcuts.palette: Open the command bar, it can do anything
shortcuts.allDone: You've got the basics. Press ? anywhere in Comail to see every shortcut.
shortcuts.aiWrite: Open a reply, then let AI write it
shortcuts.ask: Open search, then ask AI anything about your mail
shortcuts.aiDone: That's the AI toolkit. {{mod}}J works anywhere, it reads the context.

sync.title: Getting your mail ready, {{name}}.
sync.history: Older mail keeps syncing in the background.

ai.title: One key for AI: {{mod}}J.
ai.body: It reads where you are. In a conversation it summarizes, in a draft it writes, in search it answers. Try it on the sandbox.
